title: onosma austriaca
intro: Onosma austriaca, commonly known as Austrian goldenseal, is a plant species within the Apocynaceae family, native to Europe and Western Asia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Onosma austriaca include acting as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion, and its bioactive constituents, including iridoid glycosides and phenolic compounds, contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects and potential applications of Onosma austriaca in modern medicine.
